name: Gambol Pet Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Gambol Pet Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of pet food products in China, Japan, South Korea, Europe, the Americas, and internationally. The company offers pet food, including reformed meat, rawhide free, natural meat and parts, freeze dried, biscuit, wet food, vegan, rawhide, and holiday products. It also provides idea and category consultancy, product development, production, testing, and packaging services. In addition, the company is involved in trading; operations management; and supply chain management. It exports its products. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Liaocheng, China.
